Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 26d (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/autopilot-pause.mjs, tools/gate-fingerprint.mjs, tools/git-hooks.mjs, tools/goal.mjs, tools/lanes-rule.mjs, tools/release-train-merge.mjs, tools/runner-pointer.mjs, tools/swarm-env.mjs, tools/swarm/core-71.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/swarm/train3). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/autopilot-pause.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/autopilot-pause.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 45 `} catch { /* already gone */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT — releases the pause marker. Stay silent on ENOENT; if a SyntaxError reaches here log fixed text 'corrupt pause marker (SyntaxError)' (never error.message); log anything else with the marker path.

### tools/gate-fingerprint.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/gate-fingerprint.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 268 `fsPromises.unlink(tmpPath).catch(() => {})`: LOG-CLEANUP — this cleanup runs inside an error path that rethrows: bind the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT name than the outer error and console.error it (stay silent on ENOENT for an unlink of a tmp file that may never have been created); the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/git-hooks.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/git-hooks.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 157 `chmodSync(hookPath, 0o755) catch { /* best effort */ }`: LOG-ALWAYS — writeFileSync's mode option is ignored for a file that already exists, so a swallowed chmod failure can leave an existing git hook non-executable, silently disabling the pre-commit/pre-push/commit-msg guard.

Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/goal.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)

Keep dirtyList as [] in every case.

### tools/runner-pointer.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/runner-pointer.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 202 `try { await fs.access(trackedPath); hasTracked = true; } catch { /* new */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT — a missing tracked pointer file just means first link; console.error anything else (e.g. EACCES) with trackedPath. Keep hasTracked false in every catch case. Do NOT touch the git rev-parse catch at line 184.

### tools/swarm-env.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/swarm-env.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)

### tools/swarm/core-71.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/swarm/core-71.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 340 (was line 326 at audit commit 774c1a2, shifted by #416) `await cleanupRunWorkspaces(root, id, state, {...})`: LOG-ALWAYS — runs right after recording a merge-queue integration pass; no error is expected cleaning up finished run worktrees, and silently losing that cleanup can leak worktrees/disk in the merge pipeline.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
